info.ad_astra.cable: Transmit energy. Use the wrench to right-click to change the dispense mode.
info.ad_astra.cable_duct: Similar to a cable, but completely hides oxygen and prevents leaks.
info.ad_astra.coal_generator: The simplest generator. Generation of energy from combustible materials.
info.ad_astra.cryo_freezer: Convert ice materials into cryogenic fuel.
info.ad_astra.energizer: Store large amounts of energy. Right-click on an item to recharge it. Retains power when damaged.
info.ad_astra.etrionic_blast_furnace: Smelts ore into ingots like a blast furnace, but uses energy and has 4 slots. There are two modes: blast and alloy.
info.ad_astra.etrionic_capacitor: Store energy. Right click to toggle. Shift+right-click to change allocation mode.
info.ad_astra.flag: A flag with your face on it. Right click to add image from URL.
info.ad_astra.fluid_duct: Similar to fluid pipes, but completely hides oxygen and prevents leaks.
info.ad_astra.fluid_pipe: transfer fluid. Use the wrench to right-click to change the dispense mode.
info.ad_astra.gas_tank: Storage of fluids and gases. Right click to assign to your inventory.
info.ad_astra.globe: Right click to rotate the globe. Use redstone to keep it spinning.
info.ad_astra.gravity_normalizer: Allows you to control gravity in a local area. Should be used in completely sealed structures.
info.ad_astra.jet_suit: Similar to a netherite space suit, but equipped with jets that propel the wearer forward with great force.
info.ad_astra.launch_pad: Launch a rocket. Use redstone to automatically fire placed rockets.
info.ad_astra.netherite_space_suit: Similar to a space suit, but with the added advantage of protecting the wearer from extreme heat.
info.ad_astra.oxygen_distributor: Distributes oxygen and regulates temperature. Use it to create a livable environment. Should be used in completely sealed structures.
info.ad_astra.oxygen_loader: Convert water into oxygen. Use it to fill space suits and gas tanks.
info.ad_astra.oxygen_sensor: Emit a redstone signal when oxygen is detected. Shift+right click to invert the signal. Right-click to change detection objects.
info.ad_astra.radio: Play real internet streaming radio stations.
info.ad_astra.rocket: Rockets for interstellar travel. Must be placed on launch pad. Shift+right click to access its fuel and inventory.
info.ad_astra.rover: ATV. Hold down Shift and right-click to access its inventory. Tap the screen to access the rover's radio. This radio can play real radio stations.
info.ad_astra.sliding_door: Large 3x3 doors. Hold Shift and right-click with the wrench to lock. Locked doors can only be opened with a redstone signal.
info.ad_astra.solar_panel: Energy is generated from sunlight during the day. Note that the energy produced depends on the planet.
info.ad_astra.space_suit: Providing oxygen to the wearer and protecting them from the extremely cold environment of space.
info.ad_astra.ti_69: Displays local oxygen, temperature and gravity information.
info.ad_astra.water_pump: Pump water. Make sure there is a water source under the pump for it to work.
info.ad_astra.zip_gun: Push you forward. The second one can be used in the off hand to push further. Maneuvering in zero gravity is excellent.

text.resourcefulconfig.ad_astra.option.g: Allow images to be displayed on flags

Cancel the gravity and oxygen detection in the main world. Under normal circumstances, Ad Astra will not use these. You need to enable this if you are making an add-on module or need to turn the overworld into a planet.
Turn on gravity effects for entities such as items, boats, arrows, etc.
Turn on gravity effects for mobs, players, etc.

text.resourcefulconfig.ad_astra.option.o: Increased the energy required for oxygen dispensers to cover more blocks.
Maximum number of covered blocks detected

The oxygen dispenser can provide oxygen to a maximum number of blocks. Modify this data with caution as it may significantly reduce server performance. If you insist on increasing this value, please consider increasing the detection interval to ensure that thousands of blocks are not detected at one time and cause lag.
Increased the amount of oxygen required by the oxygen dispenser to cover more blocks.
At intervals the oxygen distributor is tested for structural air tightness. Detecting too frequently will reduce server TPS, so please modify it with caution.
